Method of Attack: Side-channel attack targeting operating system's page cache to extract sensitive data
Local attack requiring read access to target page, including sandboxed processes with shared files
Remote attack leveraging timing differences between memory and disk access measured remotely
Covert channel communication by accessing specific pages to transmit signals
Authentication UI redress attack by detecting window opening and overlaying fake clone
Keystroke timing attack to capture root password
Remote attack reading arbitrary data over network by distinguishing cache hits and misses
Discoverer: Research team from Graz University of Technology
Researchers: Daniel Gruss, Erik Kraft, Trishita Tiwari, Michael Schwarz, Ari Trachtenberg, Jason Hennessey, Alex Ionescu, Anders Fogh
Attack Vector: Local read access to target page via malicious process or sandboxed shared files
Remote timing measurement of soft page faults over network
Indicators of Compromise: Use of system calls 'mincore' (Linux) and QueryWorkingSetEx (Windows)
Covert channel signals via page access patterns
Timing differences in page cache hits and misses
